summary.en: Deployment units for running the Microcrawler stack on a CoreOS cluster with fleet. It holds systemd service templates for the crawler web app and workers, their data stores and a monitoring stack, each paired with a discovery unit.
summary.cs: Nasazovací jednotky pro běh Microcrawleru na CoreOS clusteru přes fleet. Obsahuje šablony systemd služeb pro webovou aplikaci a workery crawleru, jejich datová úložiště a monitoring, každou s párovou discovery jednotkou.

problem.en: A distributed crawler with a queue, a document store, a search index and many workers has to be placed across machines and the instances have to find each other.
problem.cs: Distribuovaný crawler s frontou, dokumentovým úložištěm, vyhledávacím indexem a mnoha workery je potřeba rozmístit po strojích a jednotlivé instance se musí navzájem najít.

solution.en: Every service is a templated unit that pulls and runs a Docker image, and a sidecar discovery unit writes the instance IP into etcd with a 60 second TTL, refreshed every 45 seconds. Fleet constraints keep worker instances on separate machines and bind each sidecar to its service. A start.sh script records the submit and start order as commented fleetctl commands.
solution.cs: Každá služba je šablonovaná jednotka, která stáhne a spustí Docker image, a vedlejší discovery jednotka zapisuje IP instance do etcd s TTL 60 sekund a obnovuje ho každých 45 sekund. Omezení ve fleetu drží workery na různých strojích a každý sidecar váží na jeho službu. Skript start.sh zachycuje pořadí submit a start jako zakomentované příkazy fleetctl.

highlights.en: Service discovery through etcd keys with TTL heartbeats.
highlights.cs: Service discovery přes klíče v etcd s TTL heartbeatem.

highlights.en: Units for Couchbase, Elasticsearch, Kibana, RabbitMQ, Nominatim and the gauc service.
highlights.cs: Jednotky pro Couchbase, Elasticsearch, Kibanu, RabbitMQ, Nominatim a službu gauc.

highlights.en: Monitoring with cAdvisor, Heapster, InfluxDB and Grafana.
highlights.cs: Monitoring přes cAdvisor, Heapster, InfluxDB a Grafanu.

highlights.en: X-Conflicts rule spreads worker instances across hosts.
highlights.cs: Pravidlo X-Conflicts rozkládá workery na různé stroje.

architecture.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  F[fleetctl] --> U[Service unit]
  U --> C[Docker container]
  F --> DU[Discovery unit]
  DU --> E[etcd keys with TTL]
  C --> W[Workers]
  C --> WA[Web app]
  W --> WA
  C --> M[Monitoring stack]

caption.en: Each containerised service is paired with a discovery sidecar that registers it in etcd.
caption.cs: Každá kontejnerová služba má discovery sidecar, který ji registruje v etcd.
